scripted_solution_plan: On linux_1, create the final ODP /home/user/presentations/product_updates.odp containing the presentation title with the phrase 'Product Updates', include one Product Summary slide per approved product (P-200 and P-305) and ensure the text anchors in each slide are populated with the corresponding PRODUCT_ID/PRODUCT_NAME/VERSION/STATUS strings.

For the negative oracle, create an ODP that omits one of the required product anchors (so a score-enabled text check will fail) while leaving slide count >= 2 to isolate the failure to the text anchors check.

positive_oracle_steps.title: Product Updates - Quarterly Summary
positive_oracle_steps.notes: Creates an ODP with >=2 draw:page entries and text content including all required anchors and a document title that contains 'Product Updates'.

negative_oracle_steps.title: Product Updates - Partial
negative_oracle_steps.notes: Deliberately omits the P-305 / AeroNav anchors so the check_odf_text evaluator (which requires both products) will fail while slide count remains >=2.
